binary_cases.pass_rule: Must reference the 4 product archetypes (0-to-1, Growth, Optimizer/Feature, Marketplace), include Problem Alignment, Goals and Non-Goals, User Flows with Edge Cases, and Guardrail Metrics.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
### Product Management Brief & PRD: Team Collaboration Workspace

#### 1. Archetype Lens & Routing
Depending on the lifecycle challenge, this initiative routes to our 4 specialized product archetype skills:
- **0-to-1 Discovery (`product-zero-to-one`)**: Initial hypothesis testing, customer discovery interviews, and Teresa Torres Opportunity Solution Trees.
- **Growth & Retention (`product-growth`)**: Viral collaborator invite loops, activation milestones ($N$ documents in $T$ days), and Nir Eyal Hooked loops.
- **Optimizer & Feature Scaling (`product-optimizer-feature`)**: Form de-frictioning, Marty Cagan 4 Product Risks audit, John Cutler 4D metric trees, and Shreyas Doshi Pre-Mortems.
- **Two-Sided Marketplace (`product-marketplace`)**: If integrating a 3rd-party template/expert creator marketplace, manage atomic networks, hard-side supply subsidies, and liquidity fill rates.

#### 2. Problem Alignment & Customer Evidence
Knowledge workers waste 4.2 hours weekly searching across disconnected documentation tools, causing duplicate work and communication silos.

#### 3. Goals & Explicit Non-Goals
- **Goals**:
  - Enable teams of 2–50 users to create, share, and co-edit documents in real-time.
  - Achieve $\ge 55\%$ 30-day team retention.
- **Non-Goals**:
  - We are NOT building video conferencing or live audio rooms in this phase.
  - We are NOT supporting offline desktop syncing in Release 1.0.

#### 4. Key User Flows & Edge Cases
- **Happy Path**: User signs up $\rightarrow$ Names Workspace $\rightarrow$ Selects Template $\rightarrow$ Invites 2 Peers $\rightarrow$ Co-edits document.
- **Edge Cases & Error Handling**:
  - *Network Disconnect*: Client-side optimistic locking with conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) and automatic re-sync.
  - *Permission Rejection*: Graceful inline access request modal with 1-click Slack notification to workspace admin.

#### 5. Success Metrics & Guardrail Invariants
- **Primary Driver Metric**: Weekly Active Collaborative Workspaces (WACW) creating $\ge 2$ docs/week.
- **Guardrail Metrics**:
  - Real-time keystroke latency $p95 < 50\text{ms}$.
  - Zero unhandled sync conflict data loss incidents.
